passed_checks.check_name: Ensure no hard-coded secrets exist in EC2 user data
code_block:
IrisEC2Instance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/sda1
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 100 # GB
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      ImageId: !FindInMap [RegionMap, !Ref "AWS::Region", AMI]
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref InstanceProfile
      KeyName: !Ref KeyName
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref IrisSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "iris-${AWS::StackName}-instance"
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64: |
          #!/bin/bash
          set -euo pipefail

          ########################################
          # Configuration
          ########################################
          AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="us-gov-east-1"
          LOG_FILE="/var/log/cloud-init.log"
          IRIS_DIR="/opt/iris"
          ENV_FILE="${IRIS_DIR}/api/.env"

          export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION

          exec >> "${LOG_FILE}" 2>&1

          echo "=== Starting IRIS cloud-init bootstrap ==="
          date

          ########################################
          # System prep
          ########################################
          echo "Installing dnf plugins"
          dnf install -y dnf-plugins-core

          echo "Adding Docker repo"
          dnf config-manager --add-repo=https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo

          echo "Updating system"
          dnf update -y

          echo "Installing packages"
          dnf install -y \
            docker-ce \
            docker-ce-cli \
            containerd.io \
            docker-compose-plugin \
            postgresql \
            awscli \
            curl \
            vim \
            wget \
            jq \
            git \
            rsync \
            net-tools \
            bind-utils \
            unzip \
            tar \
            lsof \
            make \
            lm_sensors \
            dmidecode \
            sysstat \
            python3-pip

          ########################################
          # Docker
          ########################################
          echo "Enabling Docker"
          systemctl daemon-reexec
          systemctl enable docker
          systemctl start docker

          ########################################
          # Wait for IAM role credentials
          ########################################
          echo "Waiting for IAM credentials"
          for i in {1..12}; do
            if aws sts get-caller-identity >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IAM credentials available"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for IAM credentials... attempt $i"
            sleep 5
          done

          ########################################
          # Secrets retrieval
          ########################################
          echo "Retrieving secrets from Secrets Manager"

          GITHUB_PAT="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
            --secret-id arn:aws-us-gov:secretsmanager:us-gov-east-1:463204515156:secret:IRIS_Repository_Personal_Access_Token-KtPMr7 \
            --query SecretString \
            --output text)"

          IRIS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
            --secret-id arn:aws-us-gov:secretsmanager:us-gov-east-1:463204515156:secret:IRIS_Service_Account_Secret_Key-CM8K4p \
            --query SecretString \
            --output text)"

          IRIS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_SECRET_KEY="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
            --secret-id arn:aws-us-gov:secretsmanager:us-gov-east-1:463204515156:secret:IRIS_Service_Account_Secret_Access_Key-019izM \
            --query SecretString \
            --output text)"
          
          SSL_CERT="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
            --secret-id IRIS_SSL_Certificate \
            --query SecretString \
            --output text)"
          
          SSL_KEY="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
            --secret-id IRIS_SSL_Private_Key \
            --query SecretString \
            --output text)"

          ########################################
          # Validate secrets
          ########################################
          if [[ -z "${GITHUB_PAT}" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: GITHUB_PAT is empty"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [[ -z "${SSL_CERT}" || -z "${SSL_KEY}" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: SSL certificate or key is empty"
            exit 1
          fi

          ########################################
          # Clone application
          ########################################
          echo "Cloning IRIS repository"
          rm -rf "${IRIS_DIR}"

          git clone \
            -b dev \
            "https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_PAT}@github.com/MetroStar/iris.git" \
            "${IRIS_DIR}"
          
          ########################################
          # Write SSL certs from Secrets Manager
          ########################################
          mkdir -p "${IRIS_DIR}/ui/ssl"
          printf '%s\n' "$SSL_CERT" > "${IRIS_DIR}/ui/ssl/nginx.crt"
          printf '%s\n' "$SSL_KEY"  > "${IRIS_DIR}/ui/ssl/nginx.key"
          chmod 644 "${IRIS_DIR}/ui/ssl/nginx.crt"
          chmod 600 "${IRIS_DIR}/ui/ssl/nginx.key"

          ########################################
          # Environment configuration
          ########################################
          echo "Configuring environment file"

          if [[ ! -f "${IRIS_DIR}/api/.env.example" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: .env.example not found"
            exit 1
          fi

          cp "${IRIS_DIR}/api/.env.example" "${ENV_FILE}"
          chmod 600 "${ENV_FILE}"

          # Safely escape sed values
          escape_sed() {
            printf '%s' "$1" | sed -e 's/[\/&]/\\&/g'
          }

          sed -i "s|your_access_key_id|$(escape_sed "${IRIS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY}")|g" "${ENV_FILE}"
          sed -i "s|your_secret_access_key|$(escape_sed "${IRIS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_SECRET_KEY}")|g" "${ENV_FILE}"
          sed -i "s|http://localhost:8080|http://keycloak:8080/auth|g" "${ENV_FILE}"
          sed -i "s|iris-raw|iris-dev-raw|g" "${ENV_FILE}"
          sed -i "s|iris-processed|iris-dev-processed|g" "${ENV_FILE}"

          ########################################
          # Launch application
          ########################################
          #echo "Starting IRIS via Docker Compose"
          #cd "${IRIS_DIR}"

          #docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d

          ########################################################
          # Install and configure Nvidia Container Toolkit
          ########################################################
          echo "Installing Nvidia Container Toolkit"
          curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/rpm/nvidia-container-toolkit.repo | \
          sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.repo
          sudo dnf install -y dnf-plugins-core
          sudo dnf config-manager --enable nvidia-container-toolkit-experimental
          export NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION=1.18.1-1
          sudo dnf install -y \
            nvidia-container-toolkit-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
            nvidia-container-toolkit-base-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
            libnvidia-container-tools-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
            libnvidia-container1-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION}
          sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker

          ########################################################
          # Install and configure Nvidia CUDA Driver
          ########################################################

          dnf install -y https://dl.fedoraproject.org/pub/epel/epel-release-latest-9.noarch.rpm
          dnf install -y kernel-devel-$(uname -r) kernel-headers-$(uname -r) dkms
          dnf groupinstall -y "Development Tools"
          dnf config-manager --add-repo https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/rhel9/x86_64/cuda-rhel9.repo
          dnf clean expire-cache
          dnf module install -y nvidia-driver:latest-dkms
          dkms autoinstall

          #############################################################################################################################################
          # Create GPU init script and systemd service to ensure NVIDIA drivers are properly initialized on boot
          # and the IRIS stack is launched after GPU setup. This is important because the NVIDIA drivers may require a reboot after installation,
          # and we want to ensure the IRIS stack starts correctly with GPU support.
          #############################################################################################################################################

          cat >/usr/local/sbin/iris-gpu-init.sh <<'EOF'
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail

          MARKER=/var/lib/iris/gpu-init.done
          mkdir -p /var/lib/iris

          if [[ -f "$MARKER" ]]; then
            echo "GPU init already completed."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "=== GPU init starting ==="
          uname -r

          # Ensure matching headers exist for the running kernel
          dnf install -y "kernel-devel-$(uname -r)" "kernel-headers-$(uname -r)" dkms || true

          # If you rely on NVIDIA's repo/module, ensure it's enabled (adjust if needed)
          dnf config-manager --add-repo https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/rhel9/x86_64/cuda-rhel9.repo || true
          dnf clean expire-cache

          echo "Running dkms autoinstall..."
          dkms autoinstall || true
          dkms status || true

          echo "Loading nvidia module..."
          modprobe nvidia || true
          lsmod | grep -E '^nvidia' || true

          echo "Restarting docker to pick up nvidia runtime (if configured)..."
          systemctl restart docker || true

          touch "$MARKER"
          echo "=== GPU init done ==="

          docker compose -f /opt/iris/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d

          echo "=== IRIS stack deployed ==="

          EOF

          chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/iris-gpu-init.sh

          cat >/etc/systemd/system/iris-gpu-init.service <<'EOF'
          [Unit]
          Description=One-time NVIDIA DKMS/module init after boot
          Wants=network-online.target
          After=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/iris-gpu-init.sh
          RemainAfterExit=yes

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
          EOF

          systemctl daemon-reload
          systemctl enable iris-gpu-init.service
          
          ########################################
          # Create SSH users
          ########################################

          USERS_FILE="/opt/iris/deploy/aws/ssh-users.yaml"
          CREATE_USER_SCRIPT="/opt/iris/deploy/aws/create_ssh_user.sh"

          chmod +x "$CREATE_USER_SCRIPT"

          while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
            # Skip blank lines and comments
            [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

            # username is everything before the first colon
            username="${line%%:*}"
            # value is everything after the first colon
            ssh_key="${line#*:}"

            # trim whitespace
            username="$(echo "$username" | xargs)"
            ssh_key="$(echo "$ssh_key" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')"

            # strip wrapping quotes if present
            ssh_key="${ssh_key#\"}"
            ssh_key="${ssh_key%\"}"

            "$CREATE_USER_SCRIPT" -u "$username" -k "$ssh_key" --no-password
          done < "$USERS_FILE"

          ########################################
          # Prepare users for sudo
          ########################################

          for username in $(awk -F: '{print $1}' "$USERS_FILE"); do
            usermod -aG wheel "$username"
            passwd -uf "$username"
          done

          ########################################
          # Completion
          ########################################
          echo "IRIS stack deployed successfully"
          date
          echo "IRIS deployed" > /var/tmp/iris.txt
          reboot

      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref IrisSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "iris-${AWS::StackName}-instance"
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64: |
          #!/bin/bash
          set -euo pipefail

          ########################################
          # Configuration
          ########################################
          AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="us-gov-east-1"
          LOG_FILE="/var/log/cloud-init.log"
          IRIS_DIR="/opt/iris"
          ENV_FILE="${IRIS_DIR}/api/.env"

          export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION

          exec >> "${LOG_FILE}" 2>&1

          echo "=== Starting IRIS cloud-init bootstrap ==="
          date

          ########################################
          # System prep
          ########################################
          echo "Installing dnf plugins"
          dnf install -y dnf-plugins-core

          echo "Adding Docker repo"
          dnf config-manager --add-repo=https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo

          echo "Updating system"
          dnf update -y

          echo "Installing packages"
          dnf install -y \
            docker-ce \
            docker-ce-cli \
            containerd.io \
            docker-compose-plugin \
            postgresql \
            awscli \
            curl \
            vim \
            wget \
            jq \
            git \
            rsync \
            net-tools \
            bind-utils \
            unzip \
            tar \
            lsof \
            make \
            lm_sensors \
            dmidecode \
            sysstat \
            python3-pip

          ########################################
          # Docker
          ########################################
          echo "Enabling Docker"
          systemctl daemon-reexec
          systemctl enable docker
          systemctl start docker

          ########################################
          # Wait for IAM role credentials
          ########################################
          echo "Waiting for IAM credentials"
          for i in {1..12}; do
            if aws sts get-caller-identity >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IAM credentials available"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for IAM credentials... attempt $i"
            sleep 5
          done

          ########################################
          # Secrets retrieval
          ########################################
          echo "Retrieving secrets from Secrets Manager"

          GITHUB_PAT="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
            --secret-id arn:aws-us-gov:secretsmanager:us-gov-east-1:463204515156:secret:IRIS_Repository_Personal_Access_Token-KtPMr7 \
            --query SecretString \
            --output text)"

          IRIS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
            --secret-id arn:aws-us-gov:secretsmanager:us-gov-east-1:463204515156:secret:IRIS_Service_Account_Secret_Key-CM8K4p \
            --query SecretString \
            --output text)"

          IRIS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_SECRET_KEY="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
            --secret-id arn:aws-us-gov:secretsmanager:us-gov-east-1:463204515156:secret:IRIS_Service_Account_Secret_Access_Key-019izM \
            --query SecretString \
            --output text)"
          
          SSL_CERT="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
            --secret-id IRIS_SSL_Certificate \
            --query SecretString \
            --output text)"
          
          SSL_KEY="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
            --secret-id IRIS_SSL_Private_Key \
            --query SecretString \
            --output text)"

          ########################################
          # Validate secrets
          ########################################
          if [[ -z "${GITHUB_PAT}" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: GITHUB_PAT is empty"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [[ -z "${SSL_CERT}" || -z "${SSL_KEY}" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: SSL certificate or key is empty"
            exit 1
          fi

          ########################################
          # Clone application
          ########################################
          echo "Cloning IRIS repository"
          rm -rf "${IRIS_DIR}"

          git clone \
            -b dev \
            "https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_PAT}@github.com/MetroStar/iris.git" \
            "${IRIS_DIR}"
          
          ########################################
          # Write SSL certs from Secrets Manager
          ########################################
          mkdir -p "${IRIS_DIR}/ui/ssl"
          printf '%s\n' "$SSL_CERT" > "${IRIS_DIR}/ui/ssl/nginx.crt"
          printf '%s\n' "$SSL_KEY"  > "${IRIS_DIR}/ui/ssl/nginx.key"
          chmod 644 "${IRIS_DIR}/ui/ssl/nginx.crt"
          chmod 600 "${IRIS_DIR}/ui/ssl/nginx.key"

          ########################################
          # Environment configuration
          ########################################
          echo "Configuring environment file"

          if [[ ! -f "${IRIS_DIR}/api/.env.example" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: .env.example not found"
            exit 1
          fi

          cp "${IRIS_DIR}/api/.env.example" "${ENV_FILE}"
          chmod 600 "${ENV_FILE}"

          # Safely escape sed values
          escape_sed() {
            printf '%s' "$1" | sed -e 's/[\/&]/\\&/g'
          }

          sed -i "s|your_access_key_id|$(escape_sed "${IRIS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY}")|g" "${ENV_FILE}"
          sed -i "s|your_secret_access_key|$(escape_sed "${IRIS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_SECRET_KEY}")|g" "${ENV_FILE}"
          sed -i "s|http://localhost:8080|http://keycloak:8080/auth|g" "${ENV_FILE}"
          sed -i "s|iris-raw|iris-dev-raw|g" "${ENV_FILE}"
          sed -i "s|iris-processed|iris-dev-processed|g" "${ENV_FILE}"

          ########################################
          # Launch application
          ########################################
          #echo "Starting IRIS via Docker Compose"
          #cd "${IRIS_DIR}"

          #docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d

          ########################################################
          # Install and configure Nvidia Container Toolkit
          ########################################################
          echo "Installing Nvidia Container Toolkit"
          curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/libnvidia-container/stable/rpm/nvidia-container-toolkit.repo | \
          sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/nvidia-container-toolkit.repo
          sudo dnf install -y dnf-plugins-core
          sudo dnf config-manager --enable nvidia-container-toolkit-experimental
          export NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION=1.18.1-1
          sudo dnf install -y \
            nvidia-container-toolkit-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
            nvidia-container-toolkit-base-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
            libnvidia-container-tools-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION} \
            libnvidia-container1-${NVIDIA_CONTAINER_TOOLKIT_VERSION}
          sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker

          ########################################################
          # Install and configure Nvidia CUDA Driver
          ########################################################

          dnf install -y https://dl.fedoraproject.org/pub/epel/epel-release-latest-9.noarch.rpm
          dnf install -y kernel-devel-$(uname -r) kernel-headers-$(uname -r) dkms
          dnf groupinstall -y "Development Tools"
          dnf config-manager --add-repo https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/rhel9/x86_64/cuda-rhel9.repo
          dnf clean expire-cache
          dnf module install -y nvidia-driver:latest-dkms
          dkms autoinstall

          #############################################################################################################################################
          # Create GPU init script and systemd service to ensure NVIDIA drivers are properly initialized on boot
          # and the IRIS stack is launched after GPU setup. This is important because the NVIDIA drivers may require a reboot after installation,
          # and we want to ensure the IRIS stack starts correctly with GPU support.
          #############################################################################################################################################

          cat >/usr/local/sbin/iris-gpu-init.sh <<'EOF'
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail

          MARKER=/var/lib/iris/gpu-init.done
          mkdir -p /var/lib/iris

          if [[ -f "$MARKER" ]]; then
            echo "GPU init already completed."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "=== GPU init starting ==="
          uname -r

          # Ensure matching headers exist for the running kernel
          dnf install -y "kernel-devel-$(uname -r)" "kernel-headers-$(uname -r)" dkms || true

          # If you rely on NVIDIA's repo/module, ensure it's enabled (adjust if needed)
          dnf config-manager --add-repo https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/rhel9/x86_64/cuda-rhel9.repo || true
          dnf clean expire-cache

          echo "Running dkms autoinstall..."
          dkms autoinstall || true
          dkms status || true

          echo "Loading nvidia module..."
          modprobe nvidia || true
          lsmod | grep -E '^nvidia' || true

          echo "Restarting docker to pick up nvidia runtime (if configured)..."
          systemctl restart docker || true

          touch "$MARKER"
          echo "=== GPU init done ==="

          docker compose -f /opt/iris/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d

          echo "=== IRIS stack deployed ==="

          EOF

          chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/iris-gpu-init.sh

          cat >/etc/systemd/system/iris-gpu-init.service <<'EOF'
          [Unit]
          Description=One-time NVIDIA DKMS/module init after boot
          Wants=network-online.target
          After=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=oneshot
          ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/iris-gpu-init.sh
          RemainAfterExit=yes

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
          EOF

          systemctl daemon-reload
          systemctl enable iris-gpu-init.service
          
          ########################################
          # Create SSH users
          ########################################

          USERS_FILE="/opt/iris/deploy/aws/ssh-users.yaml"
          CREATE_USER_SCRIPT="/opt/iris/deploy/aws/create_ssh_user.sh"

          chmod +x "$CREATE_USER_SCRIPT"

          while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
            # Skip blank lines and comments
            [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

            # username is everything before the first colon
            username="${line%%:*}"
            # value is everything after the first colon
            ssh_key="${line#*:}"

            # trim whitespace
            username="$(echo "$username" | xargs)"
            ssh_key="$(echo "$ssh_key" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')"

            # strip wrapping quotes if present
            ssh_key="${ssh_key#\"}"
            ssh_key="${ssh_key%\"}"

            "$CREATE_USER_SCRIPT" -u "$username" -k "$ssh_key" --no-password
          done < "$USERS_FILE"

          ########################################
          # Prepare users for sudo
          ########################################

          for username in $(awk -F: '{print $1}' "$USERS_FILE"); do
            usermod -aG wheel "$username"
            passwd -uf "$username"
          done

          ########################################
          # Completion
          ########################################
          echo "IRIS stack deployed successfully"
          date
          echo "IRIS deployed" > /var/tmp/iris.txt
          reboot

code_block:
# =============================================================================
# Stage 1: Builder - Install dependencies
# =============================================================================
FROM python:3.12-slim AS builder

# Install uv for fast parallel package installation
COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest /uv /uvx /bin/

WORKDIR /app

# Install build dependencies (git needed for CLIP installation)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Create virtual environment for cleaner copying
RUN uv venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH"
ENV VIRTUAL_ENV="/opt/venv"

# Copy project files needed for installation
COPY pyproject.toml .
COPY app ./app

# Install PyTorch with CUDA 12.8 to match EKS GPU node driver (570.x = CUDA 12.8).
# Must be installed first so the main install sees torch already satisfied.
RUN uv pip install --no-cache \
    --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128 \
    torch==2.11.0 torchaudio==2.11.0 torchvision==0.26.0

# Install remaining Python dependencies from pyproject.toml
RUN uv pip install --no-cache .

# Install CLIP for YOLOE text-prompted detection
RUN uv pip install --no-cache git+https://github.com/ultralytics/CLIP.git

# =============================================================================
# Stage 2: Runtime - Final slim image
# =============================================================================
FROM python:3.12-slim AS runtime

WORKDIR /app

# Install runtime system dependencies only
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ffmpeg \
    curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Copy virtual environment from builder
COPY --from=builder /opt/venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH"

# Copy application code
COPY . .

# Create non-root user for security
RUN useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appuser && \
    chown -R appuser:appuser /app
USER appuser

# Expose port

# Stage 1: Build the React app
FROM node:20.18.2-alpine@sha256:df02558528d3d3d0d621f112e232611aecfee7cbc654f6b375765f72bb262799 AS build

# Set the working directory in the container
WORKDIR /app

# Accept build arguments for environment variables
ARG VITE_SSO_AUTHORITY
ARG VITE_SSO_CLIENT_ID

# Set them as environment variables for the build process
ENV VITE_SSO_AUTHORITY=$VITE_SSO_AUTHORITY
ENV VITE_SSO_CLIENT_ID=$VITE_SSO_CLIENT_ID

# Copy package.json and package-lock.json to the working directory
COPY package*.json ./

# Install dependencies with exact versions from lockfile
# Falls back to npm install if no lockfile exists
RUN if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then \
  npm ci; \
  else \
  npm install; \
  fi

# Copy the entire app to the working directory
COPY . .

# Build the React app
RUN npm run build

# Stage 2: Serve the built app using a lightweight web server
FROM nginx:1.26.3-alpine-slim@sha256:f25f852134140e003ac967604cd1f9004a5e6abd195e8bf59bf0de303c9df35e

# Copy the built app from the previous stage
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html

# Copy the default Nginx configuration
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf

# Create non-root user and set permissions
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S appgroup && \
  adduser -u 1001 -S appuser -G appgroup && \
  chown -R appuser:appgroup /usr/share/nginx/html && \
  chown -R appuser:appgroup /var/cache/nginx && \
  chown -R appuser:appgroup /var/log/nginx && \
  touch /var/run/nginx.pid && \
  chown -R appuser:appgroup /var/run/nginx.pid

USER appuser

# Expose port 3000
EXPOSE 3000

# Healthcheck with wget
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
  CMD wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:3000/health || exit 1

# Start Nginx when the container starts
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]

FROM postgis/postgis:14-3.3

# Install all build dependencies and runtime libraries
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    git \
    libxml2-dev \
    postgresql-server-dev-14 \
    libpq-dev \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    libgdal-dev \
    libgeotiff-dev \
    libproj-dev \
    libjsoncpp-dev \
    libcurl4-openssl-dev \
    liblaszip-dev \
    zlib1g-dev \
    python3-dev \
    python3-numpy \
    pkg-config \
    autoconf \
    automake \
    libtool \
    clang-11 \
    llvm-11-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Build and install PDAL 2.4 from source (compatible with GDAL 3.2.2)
RUN cd /tmp && \
    git clone https://github.com/PDAL/PDAL.git && \
    cd PDAL && \
    git checkout 2.4.3 && \
    mkdir build && cd build && \
    cmake .. \
        -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
        -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local \
        -DWITH_LAZPERF=OFF \
        -DWITH_LASZIP=ON \
        -DBUILD_PLUGIN_PGPOINTCLOUD=ON \
        -DPostgreSQL_INCLUDE_DIR=/usr/include/postgresql \
        -DPostgreSQL_TYPE_INCLUDE_DIR=/usr/include/postgresql/14/server && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    ldconfig && \
    cd / && rm -rf /tmp/PDAL

# Build and install pgPointCloud
RUN cd /tmp && \
    git clone https://github.com/pgpointcloud/pointcloud.git && \
    cd pointcloud && \
    # Check if CMakeLists.txt exists, if not use autotools
    if [ ! -f "CMakeLists.txt" ]; then \
        ./autogen.sh && \
        ./configure --with-pgconfig=/usr/bin/pg_config && \
        make && \
        make install; \
    else \
        mkdir build && cd build && \
        cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr && \
        make -j$(nproc) && \
        make install; \
    fi && \
    cd / && rm -rf /tmp/pointcloud

# Update library cache
RUN ldconfig

# Verify installations work
RUN pdal --version && psql --version

# Clean up to reduce image size
RUN apt-get autoremove -y && apt-get clean

# Run as the existing non-root postgres user from the base image
USER postgres

# Healthcheck to verify the PostgreSQL service is accepting connections
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD pg_isready -U postgres || exit 1

FROM node:20-alpine@sha256:df02558528d3d3d0d621f112e232611aecfee7cbc654f6b375765f72bb262799 AS build

ENV VITE_SSO_CLIENT_ID=$VITE_SSO_CLIENT_ID

  CMD wget -qO- https://127.0.0.1:3000/health || exit 1

RUN cd /tmp && \
    git clone https://github.com/pgpointcloud/pointcloud.git && \
    cd pointcloud && \
    # Check if CMakeLists.txt exists, if not use autotools
    if [ ! -f "CMakeLists.txt" ]; then \
        ./autogen.sh && \
        ./configure --with-pgconfig=/usr/bin/pg_config && \
        make && \
        make install; \
    else \
        mkdir build && cd build && \
        cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr && \
        make -j$(nproc) && \
        make install; \
    fi && \
    cd / && rm -rf /tmp/pointcloud

RUN cd /tmp && \
    git clone https://github.com/pgpointcloud/pointcloud.git && \
    cd pointcloud && \
    # Check if CMakeLists.txt exists, if not use autotools
    if [ ! -f "CMakeLists.txt" ]; then \
        ./autogen.sh && \
        ./configure --with-pgconfig=/usr/bin/pg_config && \
        make && \
        make install; \
    else \
        mkdir build && cd build && \
        cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr && \
        make -j$(nproc) && \
        make install; \
    fi && \
    cd / && rm -rf /tmp/pointcloud

RUN cd /tmp && \
    git clone https://github.com/pgpointcloud/pointcloud.git && \
    cd pointcloud && \
    # Check if CMakeLists.txt exists, if not use autotools
    if [ ! -f "CMakeLists.txt" ]; then \
        ./autogen.sh && \
        ./configure --with-pgconfig=/usr/bin/pg_config && \
        make && \
        make install; \
    else \
        mkdir build && cd build && \
        cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr && \
        make -j$(nproc) && \
        make install; \
    fi && \
    cd / && rm -rf /tmp/pointcloud

    git clone https://github.com/pgpointcloud/pointcloud.git && \
    cd pointcloud && \
    # Check if CMakeLists.txt exists, if not use autotools

        ./autogen.sh && \
        ./configure --with-pgconfig=/usr/bin/pg_config && \
        make && \
        make install; \
    else \
        mkdir build && cd build && \
        cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr && \
        make -j$(nproc) && \
        make install; \
    fi && \
    cd / && rm -rf /tmp/pointcloud

# Copy the entire app to the working directory

# Build the React app

# Stage 2: Serve the built app using a lightweight web server
FROM nginx:1.27-alpine

# Copy the built app from the previous stage

# Copy the default Nginx configuration

  CMD wget -qO- https://127.0.0.1:3000/health || exit 1

CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]

code_block:
install-addons:
    name: Install EKS cluster addons
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Update kubeconfig for EKS
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Grant runner access to cluster
        run: |
          chmod +x deploy/aws/setup-cluster-access.sh
          ./deploy/aws/setup-cluster-access.sh ${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Provision S3 buckets and CORS
        # Creates iris-<env>-raw / iris-<env>-processed and applies the
        # CORS policy required for in-browser <video> playback. Without
        # this, presigned URLs are blocked by the browser and surface
        # as `(blocked:origin)` / generic CORS errors.
        run: |
          chmod +x deploy/aws/setup-s3-buckets.sh
          ./deploy/aws/setup-s3-buckets.sh ${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Provision IRSA role for iris-api
        # Creates/updates iris-api-irsa-role with a trust policy bound
        # to THIS cluster's OIDC issuer (the issuer hash differs per
        # cluster, which is why a static trust-policy file does not
        # work for new environments).
        run: |
          chmod +x deploy/aws/setup-irsa.sh
          ./deploy/aws/setup-irsa.sh ${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Install Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@v4

      - name: Apply gp3 StorageClass
        run: kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/gp3-storageclass.yaml

      - name: Run addon install script
        run: |
          chmod +x deploy/aws/install-eks-addons.sh
          ./deploy/aws/install-eks-addons.sh ${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Verify addons
        run: |
          echo "--- EKS Managed Addons ---"
          aws eks list-addons --cluster-name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }} --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

          echo ""
          echo "--- Helm Releases (kube-system) ---"
          helm list -n kube-system

          echo ""
          echo "--- StorageClasses ---"
          kubectl get storageclass

          echo ""
          echo "--- GPU Nodes ---"
          kubectl get nodes -l nvidia.com/gpu.present=true --no-headers || echo "No GPU nodes found yet"

      - name: Bootstrap summary
        run: |
          {
            echo "## EKS Cluster Bootstrap Complete"
            echo ""
            echo "**Cluster:** metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}"
            echo "**Region:** ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}"
            echo ""
            echo "### Addons Installed"
            echo "- Amazon EBS CSI Driver (EKS managed addon)"
            echo "- AWS Load Balancer Controller (Helm)"
            echo "- NVIDIA Device Plugin DaemonSet"
            echo ""
            echo "### AWS Resources Provisioned"
            echo "- S3 buckets: iris-${{ inputs.environment }}-raw, iris-${{ inputs.environment }}-processed (with CORS)"
            echo "- IAM role: iris-api-irsa-role (trust policy bound to this cluster's OIDC)"
            echo "- Cluster access: runner SG ingress on 443 + EKS access entry (cluster admin)"
            echo ""
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Update kubeconfig for EKS
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Grant runner access to cluster
        run: |
          chmod +x deploy/aws/setup-cluster-access.sh
          ./deploy/aws/setup-cluster-access.sh ${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Provision S3 buckets and CORS
        # Creates iris-<env>-raw / iris-<env>-processed and applies the
        # CORS policy required for in-browser <video> playback. Without
        # this, presigned URLs are blocked by the browser and surface
        # as `(blocked:origin)` / generic CORS errors.
        run: |
          chmod +x deploy/aws/setup-s3-buckets.sh
          ./deploy/aws/setup-s3-buckets.sh ${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Provision IRSA role for iris-api
        # Creates/updates iris-api-irsa-role with a trust policy bound
        # to THIS cluster's OIDC issuer (the issuer hash differs per
        # cluster, which is why a static trust-policy file does not
        # work for new environments).
        run: |
          chmod +x deploy/aws/setup-irsa.sh
          ./deploy/aws/setup-irsa.sh ${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Install Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@v4

      - name: Apply gp3 StorageClass
        run: kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/gp3-storageclass.yaml

      - name: Run addon install script
        run: |
          chmod +x deploy/aws/install-eks-addons.sh
          ./deploy/aws/install-eks-addons.sh ${{ inputs.environment }}

          aws eks list-addons --cluster-name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }} --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

          echo ""
          echo "--- Helm Releases (kube-system) ---"
          helm list -n kube-system

          echo ""
          echo "--- StorageClasses ---"
          kubectl get storageclass

          echo "--- GPU Nodes ---"
          kubectl get nodes -l nvidia.com/gpu.present=true --no-headers || echo "No GPU nodes found yet"

            echo "## EKS Cluster Bootstrap Complete"
            echo ""
            echo "**Cluster:** metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}"
            echo "**Region:** ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}"
            echo ""
            echo "### Addons Installed"

            echo "- AWS Load Balancer Controller (Helm)"
            echo "- NVIDIA Device Plugin DaemonSet"
            echo ""
            echo "### AWS Resources Provisioned"

            echo "- IAM role: iris-api-irsa-role (trust policy bound to this cluster's OIDC)"
            echo "- Cluster access: runner SG ingress on 443 + EKS access entry (cluster admin)"

          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

code_block:
build:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install UI dependencies
        working-directory: ui
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint UI
        working-directory: ui
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Test UI
        working-directory: ui
        run: npm run test:coverage

      - name: Build UI
        working-directory: ui
        run: npm run build

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install API dependencies
        working-directory: api
        run: |
          python -m venv .venv
          source .venv/bin/activate
          uv pip install -e ".[dev]"
          uv pip install --reinstall --no-deps opencv-python-headless==4.13.0.92
          echo "$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Test API
        working-directory: api
        run: |
          coverage run -m pytest
          coverage xml -o coverage.xml

      - name: Upload coverage artifact
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-xml
          path: api/coverage.xml
          retention-days: 30

  security-scan:
    needs: build
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
      security-events: write
      issues: write
    uses: MetroStar/epyon/.github/workflows/epyon-scan.yml@main
    with:
      scan_mode: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'quick' || 'full' }}
      coverage_artifact: coverage-xml
    secrets: inherit

        shell: bash
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          AWS_REGION: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.aws

          cat > ~/.aws/config <<EOF
          [profile govcloud]
          region = ${AWS_REGION}
          output = json
          EOF

          cat > ~/.aws/credentials <<EOF
          [govcloud]
          aws_access_key_id = ${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
          aws_secret_access_key = ${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
          EOF
      - name: Verify AWS credentials
        run: cat ~/.aws/credentials && cat ~/.aws/config && aws sts get-caller-identity --profile govcloud
      - name: Make deployment script executable
        run: chmod +x ./deploy/aws/iris-manager.sh

      - name: Delete existing stack (if any)
        run: aws cloudformation delete-stack --stack-name "${STACK_NAME}" --profile govcloud || true
      - name: Wait for stack deletion to complete (if stack exists)
        run: aws cloudformation wait stack-delete-complete --stack-name "${STACK_NAME}" --profile govcloud || true
      - name: Deploy CloudFormation stack via script
        working-directory: ./deploy/aws
        run: |
          ./iris-manager.sh deploy \
            -n "${STACK_NAME}" \
            --db-password "${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}" \
            --acm-cert-arn "${ACM_CERT_ARN}"
      - name: Wait for CloudFormation stack creation to complete
        run: |
          aws cloudformation wait stack-create-complete --stack-name "${STACK_NAME}" --profile govcloud

      - name: Update DNS to point to new stack's Load Balancer
        run: |
          export CF_API_TOKEN=${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          ./deploy/aws/iris-manager.sh update-dns \
          -n "iris-${STACK_NAME}" \
          -e dev

      - name: Wait for application to return HTTP 200
        run: |
          URL="https://iris-dev.metrostar.cloud/"
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=60
          SLEEP_SECONDS=30

          echo "Polling $URL until HTTP 200 is returned..."

          for i in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            STATUS=$(curl -k -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$URL" || true)

            echo "Attempt $i: HTTP $STATUS"

            if [ "$STATUS" = "200" ]; then
              echo "Application is live."
              exit 0
            fi

            sleep $SLEEP_SECONDS
          done

          echo "Timed out waiting for application to become healthy."
          exit 1

      - name: Output SSH connection information
        run: |
          PUBLIC_DNS=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks \
            --stack-name "${STACK_NAME}" \
            --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='PublicDNS'].OutputValue" \
            --output text --profile govcloud)

          {
            echo "## Deployment Complete 🚀"
            echo ""
            echo "Deployment complete!"
            echo ""
            echo "If your username and SSH key are present in \`ssh-users.yaml\`,"
            echo "you can connect to the EC2 instance hosting the Docker containers by running:"
            echo ""
            echo "\`\`\`bash"
            echo "ssh -i <path_to_private_key> username@${PUBLIC_DNS}"
            echo "\`\`\`"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
steps.run:
ENV="${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

build-and-push:
    name: Build and push container images
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    env:
      BUILDX_BUILDER: ""

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build and push API image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./api
          file: ./api/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:latest
          cache-from: type=gha,ignore-error=true
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,ignore-error=true

      - name: Build and push UI image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./ui
          file: ./ui/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:latest
          build-args: |
            VITE_SSO_AUTHORITY=https://iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}.metrostar.cloud/auth/realms/dev
            VITE_SSO_CLIENT_ID=dev-client
          cache-from: type=gha,ignore-error=true
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,ignore-error=true

  deploy:
    name: Deploy to EKS
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: build-and-push

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

        run: |

        run: |

      - name: Deploy Keycloak theme
        run: |

            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=theme.properties=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/theme.properties \
            --from-file=template.ftl=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/template.ftl \
            --from-file=login-username.ftl=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/login-username.ftl \

      - name: Restart Keycloak
        run: |
          kubectl rollout restart deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} --timeout=600s

      - name: Apply manifests
        run: |

          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/keycloak-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

        run: |

        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-ui -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Wait for application to return HTTP 200
        run: |

          MAX_ATTEMPTS=60
          SLEEP_SECONDS=30

            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}

      - name: Get Ingress ALB hostname
        id: get-lb
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            LB_DNS=$(kubectl get ingress iris-ingress -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
              -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].hostname}' 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$LB_DNS" ]; then

              echo "ALB hostname: $LB_DNS"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for ALB to be provisioned... attempt $i"
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Timed out waiting for ALB hostname"
          exit 1

      - name: Update Cloudflare DNS
        env:
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}

            -d "{

              \"type\": \"CNAME\",
              \"content\": \"${{ steps.get-lb.outputs.hostname }}\",
              \"proxied\": true
            }"

      - name: Deployment summary
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Deployment Complete"
            echo ""
            echo "**Cluster:** metrostar-iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
            echo "**Namespace:** ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}"

Update IRSA S3 permissions for environment
steps.run:
echo "Updating IRSA inline policy to include iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}-* buckets"
aws iam put-role-policy \
  --role-name iris-api-irsa-role \
  --policy-name IrsaS3BedrockPolicy \
  --policy-document file://deploy/aws/irsa-permissions-policy.json
echo "IRSA policy updated"

steps.name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
steps.run:
ENV="${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

steps.name: Wait for Keycloak rollout
steps.run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} --timeout=400s

steps.name: Create required databases
steps.run:
API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"
kubectl cp deploy/aws/create_databases.py \
  ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/create_databases.py
kubectl exec "$API_POD" -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- \
  python /tmp/create_databases.py

steps.name: Run bootstrap pipeline in API pod
steps.run:
API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"

# Copy bootstrap script into the API pod
kubectl cp deploy/aws/bootstrap_pipeline.py \
  ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py

# Run inside the pod where all Python deps and network access exist.
# Override env vars so the script connects to cluster services
# instead of its localhost defaults.
kubectl exec $API_POD -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- bash -c '
  export IRIS_BASE_URL=http://iris-api:5000
  export KEYCLOAK_URL=http://iris-keycloak:8080
  export QDRANT_HOST_OVERRIDE=$QDRANT_HOST
  export POSTGRES_HOST_OVERRIDE=$POSTGRES_HOST
  python /tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py
'

steps.run:
ENV="${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

name: Bootstrap data pipeline
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: deploy
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.run_bootstrap }}
    timeout-minutes: 480

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}

      - name: Update IRSA S3 permissions for environment
        run: |
          echo "Updating IRSA inline policy to include iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}-* buckets"
          aws iam put-role-policy \
            --role-name iris-api-irsa-role \
            --policy-name IrsaS3BedrockPolicy \
            --policy-document file://deploy/aws/irsa-permissions-policy.json
          echo "IRSA policy updated"

      - name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
        run: |
          ENV="${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
          RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
          PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

          # Create buckets if they don't exist
          for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
            if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
            else
              echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
              aws s3api create-bucket \
                --bucket "$BUCKET" \
                --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
                --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
            fi
          done

          # Sync seed data from dev bucket
          if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
            # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
            if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
              aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
            fi

            # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
            VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
            if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
            fi

            # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
            PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
            if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
            fi
          fi

      - name: Wait for Keycloak rollout
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          --timeout=400s

      - name: Create required databases
        run: |
          API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
            -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"
          kubectl cp deploy/aws/create_databases.py \
            ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/create_databases.py
          kubectl exec "$API_POD" -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- \
            python /tmp/create_databases.py

      - name: Run bootstrap pipeline in API pod
        run: |
          API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
            -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"

          # Copy bootstrap script into the API pod
          kubectl cp deploy/aws/bootstrap_pipeline.py \
            ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py

          # Run inside the pod where all Python deps and network access exist.
          # Override env vars so the script connects to cluster services
          # instead of its localhost defaults.
          kubectl exec $API_POD -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- bash -c '
            export IRIS_BASE_URL=http://iris-api:5000
            export KEYCLOAK_URL=http://iris-keycloak:8080
            export QDRANT_HOST_OVERRIDE=$QDRANT_HOST
            export POSTGRES_HOST_OVERRIDE=$POSTGRES_HOST
            python /tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py
          '

  update-dns:
    name: Update DNS

      - name: Get Ingress ALB hostname
        id: get-lb
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            LB_DNS=$(kubectl get ingress iris-ingress -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
              -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].hostname}' 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$LB_DNS" ]; then

    needs: deploy

        id: get-lb
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do

build-and-push:
    name: Build and push container images
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    env:
      BUILDX_BUILDER: ""

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build and push API image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./api
          file: ./api/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:latest
          cache-from: type=gha,ignore-error=true
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,ignore-error=true

      - name: Build and push UI image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./ui
          file: ./ui/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:latest
          build-args: |
            VITE_SSO_AUTHORITY=https://iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}.metrostar.cloud/auth/realms/dev
            VITE_SSO_CLIENT_ID=dev-client
          cache-from: type=gha,ignore-error=true
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,ignore-error=true

  deploy:
    name: Deploy to EKS
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: build-and-push

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig for EKS
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}

      - name: Ensure runner has cluster access
        run: |
          chmod +x deploy/aws/setup-cluster-access.sh
          ./deploy/aws/setup-cluster-access.sh ${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}

      - name: Substitute environment in manifests
        run: |
          sed -i 's/__ENVIRONMENT__/${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}/g' deploy/terraform/kubernetes/configmap.yaml
          sed -i 's/__ENVIRONMENT__/${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}/g' deploy/terraform/kubernetes/ingress.yaml
          sed -i 's/__ENVIRONMENT__/${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}/g' deploy/terraform/kubernetes/keycloak-deployment.yaml
          sed -i 's|__APP_URL__|https://iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}.metrostar.cloud|g' deploy/keycloak/dev-realm.json

      - name: Create namespace
        run: |
          kubectl create namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Deploy Kubernetes secrets
        run: |
          kubectl create secret generic iris-secrets \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-literal=db-password="${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}" \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Apply ConfigMap
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/configmap.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-nginx-configmap.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Deploy Keycloak realm config
        run: |
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-realm-config \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=dev-realm.json=deploy/keycloak/dev-realm.json \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Deploy Keycloak theme
        run: |
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-theme-login-templates \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=theme.properties=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/theme.properties \
            --from-file=template.ftl=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/template.ftl \
            --from-file=login-username.ftl=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/login-username.ftl \
            --from-file=register.ftl=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/register.ftl \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-theme-login-css \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=login.css=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/resources/css/login.css \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-theme-login-img \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/resources/img/ \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Restart Keycloak
        run: |
          kubectl rollout restart deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} --timeout=600s

      - name: Apply manifests
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-serviceaccount.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/qdrant-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/qdrant-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/keycloak-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/keycloak-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-hpa.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-hpa.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/ingress.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Update API image
        run: |
          kubectl set image deployment/iris-api \
            iris-api=${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }} \
            -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Update UI image
        run: |
          kubectl set image deployment/iris-ui \
            iris-ui=${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }} \
            -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Wait for API rollout
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-api -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          --timeout=1200s

      - name: Wait for UI rollout
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-ui -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          --timeout=600s

      - name: Wait for application to return HTTP 200
        run: |
          URL="https://iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}.metrostar.cloud/"
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=60
          SLEEP_SECONDS=30

          echo "Polling $URL until HTTP 200 is returned..."

          for i in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            STATUS=$(curl -k -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$URL" || true)
            echo "Attempt $i: HTTP $STATUS"
            if [ "$STATUS" = "200" ]; then
              echo "Application is live."
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep $SLEEP_SECONDS
          done

          echo "Timed out waiting for application to become healthy."
          exit 1

  bootstrap:
    name: Bootstrap data pipeline
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: deploy
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.run_bootstrap }}
    timeout-minutes: 480

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}

      - name: Update IRSA S3 permissions for environment
        run: |
          echo "Updating IRSA inline policy to include iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}-* buckets"
          aws iam put-role-policy \
            --role-name iris-api-irsa-role \
            --policy-name IrsaS3BedrockPolicy \
            --policy-document file://deploy/aws/irsa-permissions-policy.json
          echo "IRSA policy updated"

      - name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
        run: |
          ENV="${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
          RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
          PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

          # Create buckets if they don't exist
          for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
            if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
            else
              echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
              aws s3api create-bucket \
                --bucket "$BUCKET" \
                --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
                --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
            fi
          done

          # Sync seed data from dev bucket
          if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
            # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
            if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
              aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
            fi

            # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
            VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
            if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
            fi

            # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
            PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
            if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
            fi
          fi

      - name: Wait for Keycloak rollout
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          --timeout=400s

      - name: Create required databases
        run: |
          API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
            -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"
          kubectl cp deploy/aws/create_databases.py \
            ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/create_databases.py
          kubectl exec "$API_POD" -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- \
            python /tmp/create_databases.py

      - name: Run bootstrap pipeline in API pod
        run: |
          API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
            -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"

          # Copy bootstrap script into the API pod
          kubectl cp deploy/aws/bootstrap_pipeline.py \
            ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py

          # Run inside the pod where all Python deps and network access exist.
          # Override env vars so the script connects to cluster services
          # instead of its localhost defaults.
          kubectl exec $API_POD -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- bash -c '
            export IRIS_BASE_URL=http://iris-api:5000
            export KEYCLOAK_URL=http://iris-keycloak:8080
            export QDRANT_HOST_OVERRIDE=$QDRANT_HOST
            export POSTGRES_HOST_OVERRIDE=$POSTGRES_HOST
            python /tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py
          '

  update-dns:
    name: Update DNS
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: deploy

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}

      - name: Get Ingress ALB hostname
        id: get-lb
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            LB_DNS=$(kubectl get ingress iris-ingress -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
              -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].hostname}' 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$LB_DNS" ]; then
              echo "hostname=$LB_DNS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "ALB hostname: $LB_DNS"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for ALB to be provisioned... attempt $i"
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Timed out waiting for ALB hostname"
          exit 1

      - name: Update Cloudflare DNS
        env:
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          curl -s -X PUT \
            "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/47f764cc753c6931a599696280b1a2b9/dns_records/$(
              case "${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}" in
                dev)  echo "675c975c116507b777af783c2ffa666a" ;;
                qa)   echo "1767e36eed1885b974f57ad38dfb9063" ;;
                demo) echo "66cee90fb265fa71cc0ca368d6a8643a" ;;
                prod) echo "4a01f0f26efb68c1289a7cc9030b0aab" ;;
              esac
            )" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_API_TOKEN" \
            -d "{
              \"name\": \"iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}.metrostar.cloud\",
              \"ttl\": 1,
              \"type\": \"CNAME\",
              \"content\": \"${{ steps.get-lb.outputs.hostname }}\",
              \"proxied\": true
            }"

      - name: Deployment summary
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Deployment Complete"
            echo ""
            echo "**Cluster:** metrostar-iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
            echo "**Namespace:** ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}"
            echo "**Environment:** ${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
            echo "**API Image:** \`${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}\`"
            echo "**UI Image:** \`${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}\`"
            echo "**URL:** https://iris-${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}.metrostar.cloud/"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
