steps.name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
steps.run:
ENV="${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

        id: get-lb
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            LB_DNS=$(kubectl get ingress iris-ingress -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
              -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].hostname}' 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$LB_DNS" ]; then

          curl -s -X PUT \
            "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/47f764cc753c6931a599696280b1a2b9/dns_records/$(

results_configuration.name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
results_configuration.run:
ENV="${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

results_configuration.run:
ENV="${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

results_configuration.run:
ENV="${{ env.TARGET_ENVIRONMENT }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

build-and-push:
    name: Build and push container images
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    env:
      BUILDX_BUILDER: ""

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2

      - name: Login to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Ensure ECR repos exist
        run: |
          for REPO in "${{ env.ECR_QDRANT_REPO }}" "${{ env.ECR_KEYCLOAK_REPO }}"; do
            aws ecr describe-repositories --repository-names "$REPO" 2>/dev/null || \
              aws ecr create-repository --repository-name "$REPO" --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
          done

      - name: Relay Qdrant image to ECR
        run: |
          docker pull ${{ env.GHCR_REGISTRY }}/qdrant:v1.17.1
          docker tag ${{ env.GHCR_REGISTRY }}/qdrant:v1.17.1 \
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_QDRANT_REPO }}:v1.17.1
          docker push ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_QDRANT_REPO }}:v1.17.1

      - name: Relay Keycloak image to ECR
        run: |
          docker pull ${{ env.GHCR_REGISTRY }}/keycloak:23.0.7
          docker tag ${{ env.GHCR_REGISTRY }}/keycloak:23.0.7 \
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_KEYCLOAK_REPO }}:23.0.7
          docker push ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_KEYCLOAK_REPO }}:23.0.7

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build and push API image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./api
          file: ./api/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:latest
          cache-from: type=gha,ignore-error=true
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,ignore-error=true

      - name: Build and push UI image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./ui
          file: ./ui/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:latest
          build-args: |
            VITE_SSO_AUTHORITY=https://iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud/auth/realms/dev
            VITE_SSO_CLIENT_ID=dev-client
          cache-from: type=gha,ignore-error=true
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,ignore-error=true

  deploy:
    name: Deploy to EKS
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: build-and-push

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig for EKS
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Ensure runner has cluster access
        run: |
          chmod +x deploy/aws/setup-cluster-access.sh
          ./deploy/aws/setup-cluster-access.sh ${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Substitute environment in manifests
        run: |
          sed -i 's/__ENVIRONMENT__/${{ inputs.environment }}/g' deploy/terraform/kubernetes/configmap.yaml
          sed -i 's/__ENVIRONMENT__/${{ inputs.environment }}/g' deploy/terraform/kubernetes/ingress.yaml
          sed -i 's/__ENVIRONMENT__/${{ inputs.environment }}/g' deploy/terraform/kubernetes/keycloak-deployment.yaml
          sed -i 's|__APP_URL__|https://iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud|g' deploy/keycloak/dev-realm.json

      - name: Create namespace
        run: |
          kubectl create namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Deploy Kubernetes secrets
        run: |
          kubectl create secret generic iris-secrets \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-literal=db-password="${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}" \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Apply ConfigMap
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/configmap.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-nginx-configmap.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Deploy Keycloak realm config
        run: |
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-realm-config \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=dev-realm.json=deploy/keycloak/dev-realm.json \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Deploy Keycloak theme
        run: |
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-theme-login-templates \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=theme.properties=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/theme.properties \
            --from-file=template.ftl=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/template.ftl \
            --from-file=login-username.ftl=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/login-username.ftl \
            --from-file=register.ftl=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/register.ftl \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-theme-login-css \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=login.css=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/resources/css/login.css \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-theme-login-img \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/resources/img/ \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Apply manifests
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-serviceaccount.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/qdrant-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/qdrant-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/keycloak-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/keycloak-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-hpa.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-hpa.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/ingress.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Update API image
        run: |
          kubectl set image deployment/iris-api \
            iris-api=${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }} \
            -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Update UI image
        run: |
          kubectl set image deployment/iris-ui \
            iris-ui=${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }} \
            -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Wait for API rollout
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-api -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          --timeout=1200s

      - name: Wait for UI rollout
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-ui -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          --timeout=600s

      - name: Wait for application to return HTTP 200
        run: |
          URL="https://iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud/"
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=60
          SLEEP_SECONDS=30

          echo "Polling $URL until HTTP 200 is returned..."

          for i in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            STATUS=$(curl -k -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$URL" || true)
            echo "Attempt $i: HTTP $STATUS"
            if [ "$STATUS" = "200" ]; then
              echo "Application is live."
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep $SLEEP_SECONDS
          done

          echo "Timed out waiting for application to become healthy."
          exit 1

  bootstrap:
    name: Bootstrap data pipeline
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: deploy
    if: ${{ inputs.run_bootstrap == true }}
    timeout-minutes: 480

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Update IRSA S3 permissions for environment
        run: |
          echo "Updating IRSA inline policy to include iris-${{ inputs.environment }}-* buckets"
          aws iam put-role-policy \
            --role-name iris-api-irsa-role \
            --policy-name IrsaS3BedrockPolicy \
            --policy-document file://deploy/aws/irsa-permissions-policy.json
          echo "IRSA policy updated"

      - name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
        run: |
          ENV="${{ inputs.environment }}"
          RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
          PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

          # Create buckets if they don't exist
          for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
            if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
            else
              echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
              aws s3api create-bucket \
                --bucket "$BUCKET" \
                --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
                --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
            fi
          done

          # Sync seed data from dev bucket
          if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
            # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
            if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
              aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
            fi

            # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
            VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
            if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
            fi

            # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
            PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
            if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
            fi
          fi

      - name: Wait for Keycloak rollout
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          --timeout=400s

      - name: Create required databases
        run: |
          API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
            -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"
          kubectl cp deploy/aws/create_databases.py \
            ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/create_databases.py
          kubectl exec "$API_POD" -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- \
            python /tmp/create_databases.py

      - name: Run bootstrap pipeline in API pod
        run: |
          API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
            -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"

          # Copy bootstrap script into the API pod
          kubectl cp deploy/aws/bootstrap_pipeline.py \
            ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py

          # Run inside the pod where all Python deps and network access exist.
          # Override env vars so the script connects to cluster services
          # instead of its localhost defaults.
          kubectl exec $API_POD -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- bash -c '
            export IRIS_BASE_URL=http://iris-api:5000
            export KEYCLOAK_URL=http://iris-keycloak:8080
            export QDRANT_HOST_OVERRIDE=$QDRANT_HOST
            export POSTGRES_HOST_OVERRIDE=$POSTGRES_HOST
            python /tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py
          '

  update-dns:
    name: Update DNS
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: deploy

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Get Ingress ALB hostname
        id: get-lb
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            LB_DNS=$(kubectl get ingress iris-ingress -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
              -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].hostname}' 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$LB_DNS" ]; then
              echo "hostname=$LB_DNS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "ALB hostname: $LB_DNS"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for ALB to be provisioned... attempt $i"
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Timed out waiting for ALB hostname"
          exit 1

      - name: Update Cloudflare DNS
        env:
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          curl -s -X PUT \
            "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/47f764cc753c6931a599696280b1a2b9/dns_records/$(
              case "${{ inputs.environment }}" in
                dev)  echo "675c975c116507b777af783c2ffa666a" ;;
                qa)   echo "1767e36eed1885b974f57ad38dfb9063" ;;
                demo) echo "66cee90fb265fa71cc0ca368d6a8643a" ;;
                prod) echo "4a01f0f26efb68c1289a7cc9030b0aab" ;;
              esac
            )" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_API_TOKEN" \
            -d "{
              \"name\": \"iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud\",
              \"ttl\": 1,
              \"type\": \"CNAME\",
              \"content\": \"${{ steps.get-lb.outputs.hostname }}\",
              \"proxied\": true
            }"

      - name: Deployment summary
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Deployment Complete"
            echo ""
            echo "**Cluster:** metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}"
            echo "**Namespace:** ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}"
            echo "**Environment:** ${{ inputs.environment }}"
            echo "**API Image:** \`${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}\`"
            echo "**UI Image:** \`${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}\`"
            echo "**URL:** https://iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud/"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
steps.run:
ENV="${{ inputs.environment }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

steps.name: Wait for Keycloak rollout
steps.run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} --timeout=400s

steps.name: Create required databases
steps.run:
API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"
kubectl cp deploy/aws/create_databases.py \
  ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/create_databases.py
kubectl exec "$API_POD" -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- \
  python /tmp/create_databases.py

steps.name: Run bootstrap pipeline in API pod
steps.run:
API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"

# Copy bootstrap script into the API pod
kubectl cp deploy/aws/bootstrap_pipeline.py \
  ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py

# Run inside the pod where all Python deps and network access exist.
# Override env vars so the script connects to cluster services
# instead of its localhost defaults.
kubectl exec $API_POD -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- bash -c '
  export IRIS_BASE_URL=http://iris-api:5000
  export KEYCLOAK_URL=http://iris-keycloak:8080
  export QDRANT_HOST_OVERRIDE=$QDRANT_HOST
  export POSTGRES_HOST_OVERRIDE=$POSTGRES_HOST
  python /tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py
'

steps.name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
steps.run:
ENV="${{ inputs.environment }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

steps.run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} --timeout=400s

steps.name: Create required databases
steps.run:
API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"

steps.name: Run bootstrap pipeline in API pod

API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')

# Copy bootstrap script into the API pod

  ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py

# Run inside the pod where all Python deps and network access exist.
# Override env vars so the script connects to cluster services

  export QDRANT_HOST_OVERRIDE=$QDRANT_HOST
  export POSTGRES_HOST_OVERRIDE=$POSTGRES_HOST
  python /tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py
'

            --policy-name IrsaS3BedrockPolicy \
            --policy-document file://deploy/aws/irsa-permissions-policy.json
          echo "IRSA policy updated"

      - name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
        run: |
          ENV="${{ inputs.environment }}"
          RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
          PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

          # Create buckets if they don't exist
          for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
            if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
            else
              echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
              aws s3api create-bucket \
                --bucket "$BUCKET" \
                --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
                --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
            fi
          done

          # Sync seed data from dev bucket
          if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
            # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
            if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
              aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
            fi

            # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
            VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
            if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
            fi

            # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
            PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
            if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
            fi
          fi

      - name: Wait for Keycloak rollout
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          --timeout=400s

      - name: Create required databases
        run: |
          API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
            -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"
          kubectl cp deploy/aws/create_databases.py \
            ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/create_databases.py
          kubectl exec "$API_POD" -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- \
            python /tmp/create_databases.py

      - name: Run bootstrap pipeline in API pod
        run: |
          API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
            -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"

          # Copy bootstrap script into the API pod
          kubectl cp deploy/aws/bootstrap_pipeline.py \
            ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py

          # Run inside the pod where all Python deps and network access exist.
          # Override env vars so the script connects to cluster services
          # instead of its localhost defaults.
          kubectl exec $API_POD -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- bash -c '
            export IRIS_BASE_URL=http://iris-api:5000
            export KEYCLOAK_URL=http://iris-keycloak:8080
            export QDRANT_HOST_OVERRIDE=$QDRANT_HOST
            export POSTGRES_HOST_OVERRIDE=$POSTGRES_HOST
            python /tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py
          '

name: Update DNS
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: deploy

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Get Ingress ALB hostname
        id: get-lb
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            LB_DNS=$(kubectl get ingress iris-ingress -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
              -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].hostname}' 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$LB_DNS" ]; then
              echo "hostname=$LB_DNS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "ALB hostname: $LB_DNS"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for ALB to be provisioned... attempt $i"
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Timed out waiting for ALB hostname"
          exit 1

      - name: Update Cloudflare DNS
        env:
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          curl -s -X PUT \
            "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/47f764cc753c6931a599696280b1a2b9/dns_records/$(
              case "${{ inputs.environment }}" in
                dev)  echo "675c975c116507b777af783c2ffa666a" ;;
                qa)   echo "1767e36eed1885b974f57ad38dfb9063" ;;
                demo) echo "66cee90fb265fa71cc0ca368d6a8643a" ;;
                prod) echo "4a01f0f26efb68c1289a7cc9030b0aab" ;;
              esac
            )" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_API_TOKEN" \
            -d "{
              \"name\": \"iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud\",
              \"ttl\": 1,
              \"type\": \"CNAME\",
              \"content\": \"${{ steps.get-lb.outputs.hostname }}\",
              \"proxied\": true
            }"

      - name: Deployment summary
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Deployment Complete"
            echo ""
            echo "**Cluster:** metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}"
            echo "**Namespace:** ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}"
            echo "**Environment:** ${{ inputs.environment }}"
            echo "**API Image:** \`${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}\`"
            echo "**UI Image:** \`${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}\`"
            echo "**URL:** https://iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud/"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

name: Build and push container images

              aws ecr create-repository --repository-name "$REPO" --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
          done

      - name: Relay Qdrant image to ECR
        run: |
          docker pull ${{ env.GHCR_REGISTRY }}/qdrant:v1.17.1
          docker tag ${{ env.GHCR_REGISTRY }}/qdrant:v1.17.1 \
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_QDRANT_REPO }}:v1.17.1

name: Update DNS
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: deploy

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Get Ingress ALB hostname
        id: get-lb
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            LB_DNS=$(kubectl get ingress iris-ingress -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
              -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].hostname}' 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$LB_DNS" ]; then
              echo "hostname=$LB_DNS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "ALB hostname: $LB_DNS"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for ALB to be provisioned... attempt $i"
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Timed out waiting for ALB hostname"
          exit 1

      - name: Update Cloudflare DNS
        env:
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          curl -s -X PUT \
            "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/47f764cc753c6931a599696280b1a2b9/dns_records/$(
              case "${{ inputs.environment }}" in
                dev)  echo "675c975c116507b777af783c2ffa666a" ;;

                prod) echo "4a01f0f26efb68c1289a7cc9030b0aab" ;;
              esac
            )" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_API_TOKEN" \
            -d "{
              \"name\": \"iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud\",
              \"ttl\": 1,
              \"type\": \"CNAME\",
              \"content\": \"${{ steps.get-lb.outputs.hostname }}\",
              \"proxied\": true
            }"

      - name: Deployment summary
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Deployment Complete"
            echo ""
            echo "**Cluster:** metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}"
            echo "**Namespace:** ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}"
            echo "**Environment:** ${{ inputs.environment }}"
            echo "**API Image:** \`${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}\`"

            echo "**URL:** https://iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud/"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

build-and-push:
    name: Build and push container images
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    env:
      BUILDX_BUILDER: ""

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2

      - name: Login to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Ensure ECR repos exist
        run: |
          for REPO in "${{ env.ECR_QDRANT_REPO }}" "${{ env.ECR_KEYCLOAK_REPO }}"; do
            aws ecr describe-repositories --repository-names "$REPO" 2>/dev/null || \
              aws ecr create-repository --repository-name "$REPO" --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
          done

      - name: Relay Qdrant image to ECR
        run: |
          docker pull ${{ env.GHCR_REGISTRY }}/qdrant:v1.17.1
          docker tag ${{ env.GHCR_REGISTRY }}/qdrant:v1.17.1 \
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_QDRANT_REPO }}:v1.17.1
          docker push ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_QDRANT_REPO }}:v1.17.1

      - name: Relay Keycloak image to ECR
        run: |
          docker pull ${{ env.GHCR_REGISTRY }}/keycloak:23.0.7
          docker tag ${{ env.GHCR_REGISTRY }}/keycloak:23.0.7 \
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_KEYCLOAK_REPO }}:23.0.7
          docker push ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_KEYCLOAK_REPO }}:23.0.7

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build and push API image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./api
          file: ./api/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:latest
          cache-from: type=gha,ignore-error=true
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,ignore-error=true

      - name: Build and push UI image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./ui
          file: ./ui/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}
            ${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:latest
          build-args: |
            VITE_SSO_AUTHORITY=https://iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud/auth/realms/dev
            VITE_SSO_CLIENT_ID=dev-client
          cache-from: type=gha,ignore-error=true
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,ignore-error=true

  deploy:
    name: Deploy to EKS
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: build-and-push

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig for EKS
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Ensure runner has cluster access
        run: |
          chmod +x deploy/aws/setup-cluster-access.sh
          ./deploy/aws/setup-cluster-access.sh ${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Substitute environment in manifests
        run: |
          sed -i 's/__ENVIRONMENT__/${{ inputs.environment }}/g' deploy/terraform/kubernetes/configmap.yaml
          sed -i 's/__ENVIRONMENT__/${{ inputs.environment }}/g' deploy/terraform/kubernetes/ingress.yaml
          sed -i 's/__ENVIRONMENT__/${{ inputs.environment }}/g' deploy/terraform/kubernetes/keycloak-deployment.yaml
          sed -i 's|__APP_URL__|https://iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud|g' deploy/keycloak/dev-realm.json

      - name: Create namespace
        run: |
          kubectl create namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Deploy Kubernetes secrets
        run: |
          kubectl create secret generic iris-secrets \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-literal=db-password="${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}" \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Apply ConfigMap
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/configmap.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-nginx-configmap.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Deploy Keycloak realm config
        run: |
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-realm-config \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=dev-realm.json=deploy/keycloak/dev-realm.json \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Deploy Keycloak theme
        run: |
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-theme-login-templates \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=theme.properties=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/theme.properties \
            --from-file=template.ftl=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/template.ftl \
            --from-file=login-username.ftl=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/login-username.ftl \
            --from-file=register.ftl=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/register.ftl \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-theme-login-css \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=login.css=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/resources/css/login.css \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl create configmap keycloak-theme-login-img \
            --namespace ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
            --from-file=deploy/keycloak/themes/iris/login/resources/img/ \
            --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

      - name: Apply manifests
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-serviceaccount.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/qdrant-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/qdrant-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/keycloak-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/keycloak-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-deployment.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-service.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-api-hpa.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/iris-ui-hpa.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          kubectl apply -f deploy/terraform/kubernetes/ingress.yaml -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Update API image
        run: |
          kubectl set image deployment/iris-api \
            iris-api=${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }} \
            -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Update UI image
        run: |
          kubectl set image deployment/iris-ui \
            iris-ui=${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }} \
            -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}

      - name: Wait for API rollout
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-api -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          --timeout=1200s

      - name: Wait for UI rollout
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-ui -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          --timeout=600s

      - name: Wait for application to return HTTP 200
        run: |
          URL="https://iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud/"
          MAX_ATTEMPTS=60
          SLEEP_SECONDS=30

          echo "Polling $URL until HTTP 200 is returned..."

          for i in $(seq 1 $MAX_ATTEMPTS); do
            STATUS=$(curl -k -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$URL" || true)
            echo "Attempt $i: HTTP $STATUS"
            if [ "$STATUS" = "200" ]; then
              echo "Application is live."
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep $SLEEP_SECONDS
          done

          echo "Timed out waiting for application to become healthy."
          exit 1

  bootstrap:
    name: Bootstrap data pipeline
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: deploy
    if: ${{ inputs.run_bootstrap == true }}
    timeout-minutes: 480

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Update IRSA S3 permissions for environment
        run: |
          echo "Updating IRSA inline policy to include iris-${{ inputs.environment }}-* buckets"
          aws iam put-role-policy \
            --role-name iris-api-irsa-role \
            --policy-name IrsaS3BedrockPolicy \
            --policy-document file://deploy/aws/irsa-permissions-policy.json
          echo "IRSA policy updated"

      - name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
        run: |
          ENV="${{ inputs.environment }}"
          RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
          PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

          # Create buckets if they don't exist
          for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
            if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
            else
              echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
              aws s3api create-bucket \
                --bucket "$BUCKET" \
                --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
                --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
            fi
          done

          # Sync seed data from dev bucket
          if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
            # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
            if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
              aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
            fi

            # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
            VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
            if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
            fi

            # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
            PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
            if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
            fi
          fi

      - name: Wait for Keycloak rollout
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}
          --timeout=400s

      - name: Create required databases
        run: |
          API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
            -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"
          kubectl cp deploy/aws/create_databases.py \
            ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/create_databases.py
          kubectl exec "$API_POD" -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- \
            python /tmp/create_databases.py

      - name: Run bootstrap pipeline in API pod
        run: |
          API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
            -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"

          # Copy bootstrap script into the API pod
          kubectl cp deploy/aws/bootstrap_pipeline.py \
            ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py

          # Run inside the pod where all Python deps and network access exist.
          # Override env vars so the script connects to cluster services
          # instead of its localhost defaults.
          kubectl exec $API_POD -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- bash -c '
            export IRIS_BASE_URL=http://iris-api:5000
            export KEYCLOAK_URL=http://iris-keycloak:8080
            export QDRANT_HOST_OVERRIDE=$QDRANT_HOST
            export POSTGRES_HOST_OVERRIDE=$POSTGRES_HOST
            python /tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py
          '

  update-dns:
    name: Update DNS
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, linux, x64, govcloud ]
    needs: deploy

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}

      - name: Install kubectl
        run: |
          if ! command -v kubectl &> /dev/null; then
            curl -LO "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$(curl -Ls https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl"
            chmod +x kubectl
            sudo mv kubectl /usr/local/bin/
          fi
          kubectl version --client

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: |
          aws eks update-kubeconfig \
            --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
            --name metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}

      - name: Get Ingress ALB hostname
        id: get-lb
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            LB_DNS=$(kubectl get ingress iris-ingress -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} \
              -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].hostname}' 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$LB_DNS" ]; then
              echo "hostname=$LB_DNS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "ALB hostname: $LB_DNS"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for ALB to be provisioned... attempt $i"
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Timed out waiting for ALB hostname"
          exit 1

      - name: Update Cloudflare DNS
        env:
          CF_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          curl -s -X PUT \
            "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/47f764cc753c6931a599696280b1a2b9/dns_records/$(
              case "${{ inputs.environment }}" in
                dev)  echo "675c975c116507b777af783c2ffa666a" ;;
                qa)   echo "1767e36eed1885b974f57ad38dfb9063" ;;
                demo) echo "66cee90fb265fa71cc0ca368d6a8643a" ;;
                prod) echo "4a01f0f26efb68c1289a7cc9030b0aab" ;;
              esac
            )" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_API_TOKEN" \
            -d "{
              \"name\": \"iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud\",
              \"ttl\": 1,
              \"type\": \"CNAME\",
              \"content\": \"${{ steps.get-lb.outputs.hostname }}\",
              \"proxied\": true
            }"

      - name: Deployment summary
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Deployment Complete"
            echo ""
            echo "**Cluster:** metrostar-iris-${{ inputs.environment }}"
            echo "**Namespace:** ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}"
            echo "**Environment:** ${{ inputs.environment }}"
            echo "**API Image:** \`${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_API_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}\`"
            echo "**UI Image:** \`${{ env.ECR_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.ECR_UI_REPO }}:${{ github.sha }}\`"
            echo "**URL:** https://iris-${{ inputs.environment }}.metrostar.cloud/"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
steps.run:
ENV="${{ inputs.environment }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

steps.name: Wait for Keycloak rollout
steps.run: kubectl rollout status deployment/iris-keycloak -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} --timeout=400s

steps.name: Create required databases
steps.run:
API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"
kubectl cp deploy/aws/create_databases.py \

kubectl exec "$API_POD" -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- \
  python /tmp/create_databases.py

steps.name: Run bootstrap pipeline in API pod
steps.run:
API_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -l app=iris-api \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
echo "Using API pod: $API_POD"

# Copy bootstrap script into the API pod
kubectl cp deploy/aws/bootstrap_pipeline.py \
  ${{ env.NAMESPACE }}/$API_POD:/tmp/bootstrap_pipeline.py

# Run inside the pod where all Python deps and network access exist.
# Override env vars so the script connects to cluster services

kubectl exec $API_POD -n ${{ env.NAMESPACE }} -- bash -c '

  export QDRANT_HOST_OVERRIDE=$QDRANT_HOST
  export POSTGRES_HOST_OVERRIDE=$POSTGRES_HOST

'

ENV="${{ inputs.environment }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

          # Create buckets if they don't exist
          for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
            if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
            else
              echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
              aws s3api create-bucket \
                --bucket "$BUCKET" \
                --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
                --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

          # Sync seed data from dev bucket

            # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
            if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then

              aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true

            VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)

              echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"

            # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
            PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
            if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
              aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
            else
              echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"

results_configuration.run:
ENV="${{ inputs.environment }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

results_configuration.name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
results_configuration.run:
ENV="${{ inputs.environment }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi

results_configuration.name: Provision S3 buckets and sync seed data
results_configuration.run:
ENV="${{ inputs.environment }}"
RAW_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-raw"
PROCESSED_BUCKET="iris-${ENV}-processed"

# Create buckets if they don't exist
for BUCKET in "$RAW_BUCKET" "$PROCESSED_BUCKET"; do
  if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bucket $BUCKET already exists"
  else
    echo "Creating bucket $BUCKET"
    aws s3api create-bucket \
      --bucket "$BUCKET" \
      --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
  fi
done

# Sync seed data from dev bucket
if [ "$ENV" != "dev" ]; then
  # Always ensure session_metadata.csv exists (needed for ingest)
  if ! aws s3api head-object --bucket "$RAW_BUCKET" --key "session_metadata.csv" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Copying session_metadata.csv from iris-dev-raw"
    aws s3 cp "s3://iris-dev-raw/session_metadata.csv" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/session_metadata.csv" || true
  fi

  # Sync remaining data if videos folder is empty
  VIDEO_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/videos/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$VIDEO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing all seed data from iris-dev-raw to ${RAW_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-raw/" "s3://${RAW_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Seed videos already present in ${RAW_BUCKET}, skipping full sync"
  fi

  # Sync processed data (thumbnails, metadata, embeddings) from dev
  PROCESSED_COUNT=$(aws s3 ls "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/sessions/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0)
  if [ "$PROCESSED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Syncing processed data from iris-dev-processed to ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}"
    aws s3 sync "s3://iris-dev-processed/" "s3://${PROCESSED_BUCKET}/" --quiet
  else
    echo "Processed data already present in ${PROCESSED_BUCKET}, skipping sync"
  fi
fi
